about: SAME SKY skies, baked by tools/sky-bake.ts: linear sRGB, luminance in cd/m², illuminance in lux. The sun lies along +x of each map.

map.projection: azimuthal equidistant about the zenith, to the horizon at the unit circle

light.sun: direct sunlight, illuminance normal to the sun
light.up: mean radiance of the upper hemisphere
light.down: mean radiance of the lower hemisphere
light.upIrradiance: illuminance on a horizontal surface from above
